model.label: Mora V0
model.trainingSetting: EgoDex mid-training followed by task-specific robot post-training
model.evaluationSetting: One selected Mora V0 checkpoint per official embodiment/task; all four channels

protocol.expertReference: Per-task expert_time_step in the released scenes; validated against commit a06ee3e986df72e7faa846d3eb2afe6d5a88b48a.
protocol.protocolChanges: Task-specific Mora V0 checkpoints chosen retrospectively on recorded evaluation success. All four channels use the same selected checkpoint per task. Accepted episode indices 1–50 per channel. Reach-and-stop, 0.5 s dwell, execute 20 policy action steps per query. The native perturbation profiles and anchor selections are retained in the episode logs. The exact simulator checkout has not been independently attested for every worker.

aggregation.sr: 100 * successes / episodes per task/channel; equal channel mean per task; equal task mean over all 26 settings.
aggregation.lscr: 100 * mean episode latched_stage_completion_rate, including failures; equal channel mean per task; equal task mean over all 26 settings.
aggregation.efficiency: expert_time_step / mean successful steps_to_stable_success. Pool successful episodes across all four channels before calculating task mean efficiency. Overall values average task efficiencies over tasks with success; report valid-task counts.
aggregation.missing: null means unreported (NR). Efficiency without successes is null with no-success status. Valid-task counts are null when unreported, and 0 for an evaluated scope without successes.
aggregation.scope: Overall channel aggregates require all 26 settings. Four-channel means require all four channels. Never substitute Full-only scores for means or include duplicate reruns.
